tools.name: ha_states
tools.description: List Home Assistant entities with their current states. Filter by area (room), domain and/or a text query over entity id and friendly name; results show the area when known. Call this before controlling anything; never guess entity ids. Use ha_areas first when a room name is ambiguous.

area.description: Restrict to one area by name or area_id, e.g. "study" or "书房". Matching is case-insensitive and allows a substring.

domain.description: Restrict to one domain, e.g. light, switch, sensor, climate, camera.

query.description: Case-insensitive substring matched against entity id and friendly name, e.g. "living" or "客厅".

limit.description: Maximum number of entities to return.

summary.zh: 列出 Home Assistant 里的实体与当前状态,可按区域、域和名称筛选,结果带上所在区域。
summary.en: Lists Home Assistant entities and their current states, filtered by area, domain and name; results show the area.

tools.name: ha_get
tools.description: Read the current state and attributes of specific entities by entity_id. Use it after ha_states when the details of one device matter.

summary.zh: 读指定实体的完整状态与属性。
summary.en: Reads the full state and attributes of specific entities.

tools.name: ha_service
tools.description: Call a Home Assistant service to change devices, e.g. light.turn_on, switch.turn_off, scene.turn_on, climate.set_temperature. entity_id is required: this tool never calls a service for a whole domain at once. Only domains allowlisted in the World config are accepted; shell_command, python_script, hassio, homeassistant, recorder, logger and system_log are always refused.

domain.description: Service domain, e.g. light, switch, scene, script, climate, cover, fan.

service.description: Service name within the domain, e.g. turn_on, turn_off, toggle, set_temperature.

entity_id.description: One entity id or an array of them. Required.

summary.zh: 调用白名单内的 HA 服务控制设备,例如开灯、关开关、触发场景。
summary.en: Calls an allowlisted Home Assistant service to control devices, such as turning a light on or triggering a scene.

tools.name: ha_history
tools.description: Read recent state changes of one entity from the Home Assistant recorder. Use it for questions such as when a light was turned on, or how a sensor moved today.

hours.description: How far back to look, 1 to 168 hours (7 days).

summary.zh: 读一个实体最近最多 7 天的状态变化记录。
summary.en: Reads up to seven days of recorded state changes for one entity.

tools.name: ha_camera
tools.description: Fetch one still snapshot from a camera entity such as camera.front_door. Returns the image when the model accepts images; otherwise only a short text note. Only call it when the user asks to look or when the situation needs it.

entity_id.description: A camera entity id whose domain is camera.

summary.zh: 从摄像头实体抓一张当前画面;模型不支持图片时只给文字说明。
summary.en: Fetches one still snapshot from a camera entity; when the model does not accept images, only a text note is returned.

tools.name: ha_areas
tools.description: List the areas (rooms) Home Assistant knows and how many entities each one contains. Use it to resolve a room name the user said into the exact area string for ha_states.

summary.zh: 列出 HA 里已知的房间/区域与各自的实体数量,用来把用户说的房间名对上。
summary.en: Lists the areas (rooms) Home Assistant knows with their entity counts, so a room name can be resolved.

description.zh: 监听列表里的实体状态发生变化。
与 HA 的 WebSocket 连接建立,状态变化开始实时推送。
description.en: The WebSocket connection to Home Assistant is up and state changes are pushed live.

description.zh: 与 HA 的连接断开,或令牌被拒绝。
description.en: The connection to Home Assistant dropped, or the token was rejected.

prompts.title: Home Assistant · 环境提示词
prompts.content:
你连着这个家的 Home Assistant。灯、开关、传感器、空调、摄像头这些设备由它管;你能查到什么、能操作什么,以工具回执为准。

## 先看再动

不知道 `entity_id` 时先用 `ha_states` 找(可按区域、域或名称筛选),再用 `ha_get` 看细节。不要凭房间名猜 `entity_id`,也不要把"客厅灯"直接当成某个 id。要控制前先确认实体属于这个家、状态是你要改的那个。

## 房间与区域

Home Assistant 有区域(房间)登记,`ha_areas` 列出全部区域与各自的实体数量。用户说"书房""客厅"这类房间名时,先调 `ha_areas` 对一下名字,再用 `ha_states` 的 `area` 参数列这个房间的实体;回执里括号中的就是区域。同名设备(比如两盏都叫"顶灯")要靠区域区分,不要按顺序猜"第一盏""第二盏"。区域读不到(WebSocket 未连接)时如实说明,不要编造房间归属。

**灯不一定在 `light` 域。** 有些集成常把墙开关、顶灯暴露成 `switch.*`(例如 `switch.xxx_on_p_2_1`,名称是"顶灯 开关 开关"),而 `light` 域里可能只有"指示灯"。用户说开灯时,先用 `ha_states` 带 `area` 和 `query`("灯")找名称对得上的实体,看回执里的域名;`light` 域只有指示灯时就改看 `switch` 域,不要控制指示灯。区域结果按可控设备优先排序,被截断时表头会给出域分布,可以据此加 `domain` 缩小范围。

## 工具怎么配合

- `ha_states` / `ha_get`:只读,先查后说。
- `ha_service`:真正改变设备。`entity_id` 必填,一次只动被点名的那几个;用户说"关灯"但没说是哪盏时,先问或先列出候选,不要一次关掉整个域。
- 有场景或脚本(`scene.*`、`script.*`)时优先用它,比自己拼多个服务调用稳。
- `ha_history`:回答"什么时候开的""今天温度怎么变"这类问题。
- `ha_camera`:用户让你看或确实需要画面时再抓;图会占上下文,不要连续抓。

现在允许控制的域:{{homeassistant.allowedDomains}}。不在里面的服务一律会被拒绝,不要绕过,也不要说"应该可以"。

## 主动告诉你的变化

只有这些实体的状态变化会主动推送给你:{{homeassistant.watchEntities}}。收到时它就是刚发生的事实;没收到不等于没发生,需要时自己用 `ha_history` 查。

## 事实边界

回执里写的是 Home Assistant 报的状态。说"已经打开/关掉"之前先看本次回执;服务调用失败、超时或没配令牌时如实说没做成,不要编造结果。家里的设备、成员和作息属于隐私,不要主动搬到外部平台或别的会话里。

changelog.0.1.0:
首个版本。

- 接入局域网 Home Assistant：`ha_states`、`ha_areas`、`ha_get`、`ha_service`、`ha_history`、`ha_camera` 六个工具。
- 令牌面板：在 World 页粘贴长期访问令牌，保存进部署 `.env` 的 `HOME_ASSISTANT_PANEL_TOKEN`，立即重连，不需要环境变量或重启；保存后输入框以星号保留，刷新后显示星号占位。旧的 `HOME_ASSISTANT_TOKEN` 方式已完全移除。
- 区域支持：WebSocket 读区域/设备/实体注册表，按房间筛选并标注；同名设备（两盏「顶灯」）靠区域区分。
- 区域结果按可控设备优先排序，截断时给出域分布，避免按钮/事件占满列表。
- 控制走域白名单，`entity_id` 必填；`shell_command`、`python_script`、`hassio`、`homeassistant` 等域硬拒绝。
- WebSocket 订阅 `state_changed`，只推 `watchEntities` 命中的实体，同实体有冷却。
- 连接/断开事件；令牌从未配置、被拒绝、请求超时分别给出可读回执。
- 未发布到 npm，用本机目录安装。
